member.name: T:PeroTools2.Error.ErrMsgAttribute
member.summary:
Used on an error enum field to declare the default message template of its companion error class.
An error enum field carrying this attribute gets a companion error class generated by PeroTools2.PeroError.Generator.

remarks.para: The format string uses C# interpolated string syntax, for example "File {path} Do Not Exist":

list.item: A placeholder such as {name} must match a parameter name declared by , otherwise it is a compile error
Placeholders support alignment and format specifiers, for example {retryCount,5} / {line:X4}
Literal braces are escaped as {{ and }}
